visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a colorful graphic title card overlaid on a background of fresh white roses wrapped in pink paper. A small circular avatar featuring a cartoon character (Wreck-It Ralph) is positioned near the top. The scene is brightly lit, showcasing pink and white floral textures. (2) The camera transitions to a rapid-fire sequence within a large warehouse retail environment. The first product shown is bulk packs of purple and white Kleenex toilet paper stacked high on warehouse shelving. Bright overhead industrial lighting illuminates the plastic packaging. (3) The perspective shifts to large purple boxes of Arm & Hammer cat litter. The camera remains mostly static for each product shot, focusing on the center of the frame where large text overlays appear. (4) The scene cuts to refrigerated meat sections, showing plastic-wrapped trays of Australian lamb chops with bright red meat and white fat visible. (5) A series of quick cuts follows, showcasing various packaged snacks: shredded squid, mini Snickers bars in red bags, and boxes of almond fish crackers. The background consistently features stacked warehouse inventory and industrial shelving. (6) The footage continues through the aisles, displaying Kirkland-branded chocolate crepes in green boxes, glass jars of colorful fruit candies, and blue bags of Calbee pea snacks. (7) The montage moves to red tubes of Pringles, red boxes of Glico biscuits, and luxury Godiva chocolate boxes. Each cut is precise, centering the product against the backdrop of the store's massive scale. (8) The camera focuses on alcoholic beverages, including bottled whisky and sparkling wine arranged in boxes. The lighting is sharp and direct, reflecting off the glass and plastic surfaces. (9) Moving to fresh produce, the video shows containers of black grapes, blueberries, large bags of Australian white potatoes, and bundles of fresh green spring onions. (10) Dairy and beverage aisles are featured next, showing stacks of Binggrae flavored milk, yellow packs of Yakult, and white tubs of yogurt. (11) The final sequence covers dry goods and frozen items, including Wu Mu noodles, freshly baked cinnamon rolls, frozen sea bass, mussels, and egg tofu. The video concludes with household health items like Starbucks coffee beans, Quaker oats, Always sanitary pads, and bottles of Centrum vitamins.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with high-energy, upbeat electronic pop background music (BGM) featuring a steady percussive beat and bright synthesized textures. A male voice with high vocal arousal and clear articulation quickly introduces the 'Costco weekly special report' in Traditional Chinese. (2) The narrator begins a rapid-fire delivery of product names and pricing details. His speech rate is extremely fast, listing original prices, discounts, and final special prices for items like Kleenex and cat litter. The BGM remains consistent in the background at a moderate volume level. (3) As the list continues through meat and snack sections, the narrator maintains a rhythmic cadence that mirrors the visual cuts. The audio signal is very clean, indicating a studio-recorded voice-over with high harmonics-to-noise ratio and professional compression. (4) The narration continues without pause for the duration of the video, covering dozens of items. The voice exhibits a friendly and enthusiastic tone, typical of a promotional announcement. There are no significant ambient noises or disruptive sound effects, only the persistent BGM and the high-density vocal track. (5) Toward the end, the pace remains constant as the narrator finishes with health and vitamin supplements. The music concludes with a sharp cutoff as the video ends, without a significant fade-out.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To quickly inform Costco members about the weekly discount items and special prices available between February 10th and 16th, encouraging viewers to visit the store and follow the creator for more updates.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Detailed pricing, store location specifics, and promotional dates for Costco products.
